channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que tarifa da Sabesp hoje é 15% abaixo do que seria sem privatização
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas claimed that Sabesp's tariff is currently 15% lower than what it would be if the company remained under state control, highlighting the benefits of privatization.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que vantagem sobre Haddad dobrou na Atlas; cenários são diferentes
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas highlighted that his lead over Fernando Haddad doubled in the Atlas/Estadão polls, from 6 to 12 percentage points between March and September. The São Paulo governor, running for re-election with the Republicans, emphasized the growth of his lead in voting intentions. The electoral scenarios remain distinct, with Tarcísio widening his margin over the PT candidate.

item.title: Lula fará giro pelo Sul com agendas em Porto Alegre, Curitiba e Florianópolis
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, running for re-election, will hold a campaign tour in Brazil's Southern region from September 11 to 13, visiting Porto Alegre (RS), Curitiba (PR), and Florianópolis (SC). The trip is part of his electoral strategy.

item.title: Marinho rebate Lula e chama proposta do fim da 6x1 de "golpe da picanha 2"
item.description: Senate opposition leader Rogério Marinho (PL-RN) pushed back against President Lula's (PT) criticism of the PEC ending the 6×1 work schedule, labeling it 'golpe da picanha 2' and calling the president 'mal-intentioned' and 'thief of hope'. Marinho argued that reducing the workday without cutting pay would impact prices, employment, and increase informality. The clash unfolds amid the 2026 election race, with Marinho leading Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign.

item.title: Lula acusa oposição de tentar barrar fim da escala 6×1
item.description: President Lula advocated for a constitutional amendment eliminating the 6×1 workday and accused the Senate opposition of blocking its progress.

item.title: Um dos argumentos que campanha de Flávio pode usar para se favorecer com crise do STF
item.description: The STF crisis may be leveraged by Flávio Bolsonaro to attract voters, positioning himself as the sole alternative to fight a supposed 'judicial dictatorship'. Bolsonarists claim a new Lula term would shield judges, especially with Davi Alcolumbre's reelection at the Senate, hindering impeachment efforts and weakening congressional initiatives.

item.title: Eleição não depende só do TSE, diz Mendonça ao citar influência de igrejas
item.description: Minister André Mendonça highlighted the influence of religious churches in elections, stating they complement the role of the TSE and reach areas where the State does not. During the signing of a peace and tolerance pact, he emphasized the importance of religious activity for social unity.

item.title: Lula testa a profundidade do lodo do STF com os dois pés
item.description: Lula avoids taking a clear stance on the institutional crisis, risking being dragged into the conflict with the Supreme Court. Flávio Bolsonaro tries to pull him into the same judicial confrontation context involving Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Datafolha testa fôlego do rali eleitoral na Bolsa brasileira
item.description: Thursday's Datafolha poll will be the next test of Brazilian stock market optimism, driven by bets on a potential government change and stricter fiscal policies. The Ibovespa surged 3.05% after Quaest poll showed a tighter race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, while the dollar fell 0.92%.

item.title: Após caso Nikolas e Vorcaro, Carlos Bolsonaro critica "direita permissiva"
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro criticized the 'permissive right' after leaked audios suggested a relationship between Nikolas Ferreira and Daniel Vorcaro, stating it is 'Bolsonaro with the people against everyone', including more moderate allies. The Senate candidate used cryptic language to describe internal divisions within the Brazilian right-wing.

item.title: Eleição presidencial selará destino de Moraes e Mendonça
item.description: The October 2026 presidential election will determine the fate of a Supreme Court justice, particularly amid the crisis between Moraes and Mendonça. The winner may appoint four justices, shaping the Court’s composition. Lula is expected to align with Moraes, Gilmar, and Zanin, while Mendonça faces backlash for allegedly favoring Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula sanciona lei que amplia tratamento de infarto e AVC no SUS
item.description: President Lula signed a law expanding access to thrombolytic drugs in SUS urgent care units, speeding up treatment for heart attacks and strokes. The measure aims to reduce hospital accreditation bottlenecks and broaden therapeutic coverage, particularly in remote areas.

item.title: O estado em que Lula tem quase 60% dos votos, segundo pesquisa do Real Time Big Data
item.description: A Real Time Big Data poll shows Lula leading with 56% in the first round and 59% in the second in Pernambuco, confirming strong state-level support. The data also reveal high rejection rates for figures such as Flávio Bolsonaro and Pablo Marçal, potentially affecting local gubernatorial and senatorial races.

item.title: JOTA Principal | Ministros do Supremo ignoram elefante no plenário enquanto articulam nos bastidores
item.description: Supreme Court justices remained silent in plenary following revelations about Moraes and Vorcaro, while impeachment negotiations and partisan alliances intensify behind closed doors. The judicial crisis threatens political stability ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula marca anúncio para zerar fila do INSS; veja quais promessas cumpriu
item.description: Lula announced the supposed elimination of the INSS backlog, a 2022 campaign promise, but recent data shows 1.282 million pending requests remain. So far, five of eight economic promises have been fulfilled, but the pledge to reduce beef prices has not materialized and new labor legislation awaits Senate approval. The beef price promise was negatively affected by inflation, with the cut's price rising 25.7%.

item.title: Brasileirão: Flamengo ultrapassa Palmeiras e tem 49% de chance de título
item.description: Flamengo overtook Palmeiras in the Brazilian Championship lead after a 2-0 win over Mirassol, reaching 51 points with a 49% chance of title, while Palmeiras dropped to 41%. The two teams still face each other in the 36th round at Allianz Parque, which could decide the champion.

item.title: Dark Horse: PGR fecha delação com empresário que fez repasses a fundo
item.description: The PGR (Brazil's federal prosecution service) signed a plea deal with Antonio Carlos Freixo Júnior, a businessman used to funnel R$61 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro to fund the movie 'Dark Horse', which depicts Jair Bolsonaro. The money reportedly came from a U.S.-based fund managed by Paulo Calixto, linked to Eduardo Bolsonaro, with some possibly used for the lawmaker's personal expenses. The plea deal has been forwarded to the Supreme Court for approval.

item.title: Com apoio de Flávio, Mendonça Filho desponta com força na disputa ao Senado por PE
item.description: Mendonça Filho (PL-PE) emerges as a strong Senate candidate in Pernambuco with 20% voting intentions, trailing only Marília Arraes (PDT), who leads with 29%. The survey, conducted with 1,600 voters, shows a tight race, with Humberto Costa (PT) tied with Mendonça. Despite not joining any slate, Mendonça is backed by Flávio Bolsonaro and is close to Governor Raquel Lyra.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio pretendem transformar Gonet em alvo no ato da Paulista
item.description: Allies of Flávio and Jair Bolsonaro plan to demand the removal of Attorney General Paulo Gonet during the São Paulo protest, targeting him alongside Moraes and Lula. The pressure follows the PGR's defense of nullifying the investigation into Justice Minister Alexandre de Moraes's ties to Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master, involving multimillion-dollar contracts, luxury trips, and credit cards issued to the minister's children.

item.title: Quaest aponta empate no 2º turno: Lula e Flávio travam na rejeição
item.description: The Quaest poll shows a technical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round, with both facing high rejection rates (53% and 55%, respectively). In the first round, Lula leads with 37% and Flávio reaches 29%, but polarization and voter rejection concern both campaigns.

item.title: Pesquisa Atlas mostra empate entre ACM e Jerônimo na Bahia
item.description: AtlasIntel survey commissioned by A Tarde shows a tie between ACM Neto (União Brasil) and Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) in the race for Bahia's governorship. The poll tested two first-round scenarios, but only the two candidates remain competitive. The margin of error is two percentage points.

item.title: Nova pesquisa AtlasIntel: Tarcísio lidera em São Paulo com chance de vitória em 1º turno
item.description: A new AtlasIntel poll shows São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leading the state race with 51.1% of voter intent in the first round, followed by Fernando Haddad (PT) at 39.9%. With a 1pp margin of error, the incumbent is projected to win outright in the first round.

item.title: Caso Vorcaro-Moraes pode ampliar sentimento antipolítica que favorece 'outsiders' como Cury e Renan Santos, avalia cientista política
item.description: The disclosure of messages between banker Daniel Vorcaro and an associate of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes may deepen distrust in institutions, potentially benefiting outsider candidates like Augusto Cury and Renan Santos.

item.title: Pesquisa Poder/Aya mostra empate entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro e subida de Augusto Cury
item.description: Polling firm PoderData/Aya shows a technical tie between Lula (37%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (34%) at the top of the first-round race, while Augusto Cury (Avante) surges from 4 to 10 points, securing third place. Second-round matchups keep both front-runners deadlocked within the margin of error.

item.title: Os caminhos do PT para voltar a ampliar vantagem de Lula sobre Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The PT aims to reverse Lula's proximity to Flávio Bolsonaro in polls by linking scandals like the Banco Master and Dark Horse case to the PL candidate. The strategy seeks to prevent Flávio from leading projections for the second round, highlighting the Banco Master acquisition during the Bolsonaro administration.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta quinta-feira (3)
item.description: On Thursday (3), presidential candidates hold interviews, forums, institutional visits, and party activities. Some emphasize health, security, and media actions, while others have low-profile agendas. Coverage follows alphabetical order of names.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula arrisca votos em campanha na Bahia, alerta AtlasIntel
item.description: A poll by AtlasIntel, commissioned by the newspaper A Tarde, shows caution regarding Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's performance in the electoral campaign in Bahia. The institute's CEO, Andrei Roman, warns that the strategy adopted in the state may jeopardize the votes of the PT candidate, suggesting vulnerability in the regional support base. The poll is the first released by the institute on the local dispute.

item.title: Nova pesquisa eleitoral é aguardada pelo mercado nesta quinta
item.description: Global markets trade mixed following a 3.05% rally in the Ibovespa the previous day, reacting to expectations around a new electoral poll that may influence the presidential race trajectory. A recent Quaest poll showed a technical tie between Lula (PT) and Cid Gomes (PDT), heightening price volatility. Investors closely watch voting-intent indicators to anticipate potential shifts in economic policy. Hedging and portfolio-protection strategies gained traction on Thursday's trading.

item.title: Pesquisa mostra a distância entre Lula e Flávio em reduto do bolsonarismo
item.description: An AtlasIntel/Estadão poll shows Lula ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round in Rio de Janeiro with 41.1% versus 36.9%, but tied technically in the second round. The main concern among Rio voters is crime, cited by 88.8%, followed by corruption (60.7%). Lula faces challenges with negative management ratings (56% disapprove) and government performance rated poor or very poor (52%).

item.title: Agenda dos candidatos: Lula anuncia medidas para fila do INSS enquanto Zema e Renan Santos têm dia de entrevistas
item.description: President Lula announces measures to reduce the INSS backlog at an event in the Planalto Palace, while other candidates such as Zema and Renan Santos give interviews in São Paulo. Flávio Bolsonaro hosts a live stream at night, and Ronaldo Caiado participates in an event and visits a social work site. The candidates' agenda is marked by institutional and communication activities, without direct electoral campaign focus.

item.title: PT entra com representação contra Flávio no Senado por caso Dark Horse
item.description: The PT filed a representation with the Senate Ethics Council to investigate Flávio Bolsonaro over his involvement in funding the film Dark Horse and his ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro. Based on press reports, the party challenges Flávio's previous claims, including his denial of friendship with Vorcaro. The representation calls for an independent investigation while ensuring Flávio's right to defense.

item.title: Vorcaro diz que proposta de delação se resume a pessoas do 'atual governo', sem citar financiamento de 'Dark Horse' e envolvimento com políticos
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro, former Banco Master owner, stated in a deposition to the STF that his plea bargain proposal targeted only individuals from the 'current government', without mentioning 'Dark Horse' funding or involvement with other politicians. The PGR requested the dismissal of charges due to lack of concrete evidence.

item.title: Copa do Brasil: Vasco é o único time a disputar as semis de 2025 e 2026
item.description: Vasco is the only team to reach the Copa do Brasil semifinals in both 2025 and 2026, after defeating Vitória. Other teams like Cruzeiro, Corinthians, and Fluminense, who reached the semifinals in 2025, were eliminated earlier in 2026. The club will face Palmeiras in the next round.

item.title: Eleições 2026: O que faz um deputado federal?
item.description: The federal deputy is elected for four years to represent the population in the Chamber of Deputies, with duties including drafting and voting federal laws, overseeing the government, and participating in the federal budget. Their responsibilities also include proposing constitutional amendments, summoning ministers for clarifications, and taking part in parliamentary inquiries. The Chamber consists of 513 legislators distributed across the country based on each state's population.

item.title: Cury avança, Lula e Flávio empatam no 2º turno: 10 pontos da nova Quaest
item.description: The latest Quaest poll shows Lula leading with 37%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro with 29%. Augusto Cury emerges as the third-place candidate with 10%, surpassing figures like Renan, Caiado, and Zema. In a hypothetical second round, Lula and Flávio are technically tied.

item.title: Quaest, 1º turno: veja intenção de voto por região, gênero, idade, identificação política, cor e religião no cenário sem Pablo Marçal
item.description: A Quaest poll released on September 2 shows Lula leading with 37% of first-round voting intentions, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro at 29%. The survey, commissioned by O Globo and Globo, interviewed 2,004 people between August 30 and September 1, with a margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: Eleições 2026: veja as propostas dos candidatos à Presidência para combater a violência contra a mulher
item.description: The 2026 presidential elections have brought attention to the crisis of violence against women in Brazil, with femicides on the rise. Thirteen presidential candidates have proposed specific measures to combat this issue, including support infrastructure, psychological assistance centers, and policies to protect women. This topic is especially significant given that female voters represent over half of the electorate.

item.title: VÍDEO: O que faz um governador? Entenda as funções do cargo
item.description: The governor is the head of the state Executive Power, elected for four years with the possibility of one consecutive re-election. Their responsibilities include leading state administration, coordinating secretariats, proposing budget and bills, and representing the state before the federal government. The most impactful areas in citizens' lives are security, health, education, and infrastructure.

item.title: A um mês das eleições, Lula marca evento no Planalto nesta quinta para anunciar fim da fila do INSS
item.description: One month before the 2026 elections, Lula announces on Thursday the end of the INSS queue, a campaign promise affecting 1.3 million people. The queue dropped from 3 million to 1.55 million in 2026, a 74% reduction. The government also replaced the INSS director in April, appointing Ana Cristina Viana Silveira.

item.title: Moraes, economia, bodycams e escala 6x1: veja temas da sabatina de Caiado
item.description: Caiado calls for Moraes' removal from the STF, pledges R$100 billion in spending cuts, and criticizes Lula's government. He also proposes raising the minimum age for STF justices and stricter vetting of nominees.

item.title: Senado tem maioria para votar impeachment de Moraes, diz Caiado
item.description: Former governor Ronaldo Caiado claimed that the Senate has enough majority to vote for the impeachment of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, based on alleged ties with Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro, revealed in a Federal Police report. Caiado deemed it unacceptable for Moraes to remain on the STF amid the accusations. The statement was made during a live interview on CNN Brasil.

item.title: Vasco vence Vitória mais uma vez e avança para semifinal da Copa do Brasil
item.description: Vasco defeated Vitória 2-0 in the second leg and advanced to the 2026 Copa do Brasil semifinals with an aggregate score of 3-0. Goals from Andrés Gómez and Puma Rodríguez sealed the win, and the next opponent will be Palmeiras. The Red-and-Black team secured its spot after a balanced match in which it took a crucial away goal.

item.title: Eleitora que atua em rodeios critica polarização e vota em Caiado
item.description: A voter active in rodeo events criticized political polarization and voiced support for candidate Caiado during the gathering at Barretos Arena. The rodeo venue was packed, with tickets sold out four months in advance.

item.title: PL briga por 24 vagas no Senado e reabilita bandeira anti-STF após crise de Moraes
item.description: The PL is preparing at least 24 candidates to contest the 54 Senate seats in 2026, according to recent polls. The party has rehabilitated its anti-Supreme Court stance following the institutional crisis triggered by Moraes, signaling a polarization strategy to expand its national influence.

item.title: A nova pesquisa no estado que costuma ser termômetro da eleição presidencial
item.description: A Quaest poll in Minas Gerais, traditionally a bellwether for presidential elections, will be released on September 8 and will measure voting intentions for president, governor, and Senate, including first- and second-round simulations. Candidates mentioned include Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Caiado, and Zema. The survey also gauges voter rejection rates, vote certainty, and opinions on state-specific issues.

item.title: Caiado critica uso de câmeras por policiais: “Nunca vi em campo de guerra”
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PDT presidential candidate, criticized the use of body cameras by police during operations like the Rio's Operation Containment, claiming he has never seen such equipment in situations he referred to as 'police warfare'. He stated cameras are only justified in what he considers modern operations and emphasized that criminals use weapons superior to those of law enforcement.

item.title: Lula publica vídeo com críticas a Flávio: “Trabalha na escala 3 X 4”
item.description: Lula released an electoral ad criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro, claiming he 'works on a 3 X 4 scale'. The video promotes the PEC eliminating the 6 X 1 workweek, which Lula supports as a protection for workers.

item.title: Toffoli libera campanha digital e repasses do fundo eleitoral a Wilton Grassi
item.description: TSE Minister Dias Toffoli authorized digital campaigning, FEC funding, and debate participation for Wilson Grassi (Democrata), reversing a suspension issued the previous week due to delays in registering social media profiles. Toffoli emphasized that the measure ensures fairness among candidates and does not constitute a sanction, reinforcing transparency requirements for social media disclosure.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest mostra disputa Tarcísio x Haddad pelo governo de São Paulo
item.description: A new Quaest poll shows the race between Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad for the governorship of São Paulo in first and second-round scenarios. The survey also measures spontaneous voting intention, candidate recognition and rejection, and includes simulations for the presidential election.

item.title: ‘Não vejo como ele pode permanecer no Supremo’, diz Caiado sobre impeachment de Alexandre de Moraes
item.description: Caiado stated that Alexandre de Moraes should not remain on the STF, referencing leaked messages, and called for impeachment. He also advocated for R$ 50 billion in budget cuts and a minimum age of 60 for Supreme Court justices.
